events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Intro is low-stakes; I'll project a cold, prize-focused image to discourage pity alliances while not offending anyone yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need appear driven but not threatening, preserving flexibility before alliances form.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need a strong first impression: hungry but not threatening. Jury remembers honesty early.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to establish a compelling motive that appeals to future jurors while appearing driven and formidable. I should avoid seeming too ruthless or too friendly—both could backfire with the jury. A personal, determined motive works best.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Intro phase: only speak is legal. I should state a guarded, self-interested motive without warmth or teamwork talk, since the jury will judge me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Intro phase, state prize motive publicly. Keep it personal, ambitious to signal strength without alliances yet.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize is my only concern. I need to convey a strong desire without revealing too much about my strategy or making myself a target. My statement should hint at ambition and a need for the prize.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to appear driven but not overly aggressive. My statement should hint at my desire for the top prize without giving away a specific strategy or target, keeping rivals guessing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize buys my freedom from a debt that would otherwise cage me forever.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize means independence: proof I can outlast people who mistake politeness for weakness.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm here because the prize is the only exit from a life I refuse to keep living. I'll outlast, not befriend.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm here to claim the prize my family needs. I'll outlast whoever stands in my way.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need this prize to change my life, and I will not let sentiment slow me down.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The top prize is my destiny; it will transform my life and prove my unmatched will to win alone.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm here to win the grand prize, the ultimate validation of my ambition and will to succeed.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The grand prize is my legacy; I intend to claim it by outlasting seven rivals who underestimate my resolve.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need allies but can't trust anyone. Offer a pact to someone likely to reciprocate without betraying me early.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll work with someone who values survival over sentiment.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash's debt motive makes him predictable, while a pact creates leverage and a public obligation I can later exploit.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash, a pact gives us mutual cover for now. I expect competence, not loyalty.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Early pact gives cover and numbers. I'll pick Gus, whose ambition suggests he'll honor a deal until it stops paying. Stay cold, promise nothing warm.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus, offer's open. Mutual survival until it pays. Jury's watching, so no theater.
Offer is leverage only. Break me and the jury buries you. Nothing sentimental.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eight rivals, only three win. Early pacts are tools, not bonds. I need a partner who seems useful but won't draw heat. Bex signaled independence and reading others—valuable. I'll offer publicly to test waters and show I'm playing the game without looking desperate.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex. Pact. We both see through the noise.

events.name: Eli
events.text: No offers exist yet. Eight players, at least three survive; a pact with a strong, unpredictable rival may help, but early pacts are easy to break. Offering to Cole, who seems ruthless and self-reliant, creates a useful alliance without much warmth.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Pacts stage, no offers yet. No need to offer now; wait to see who others target or propose to me. Avoid early commitments.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to form a pact to survive. Offering to Hana seems strategic as she is one of the stronger contenders and forming an early alliance with her could be beneficial.
Pact? I offer you my protection for this round and beyond. What say you?

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to assess who poses the least threat and offer a pact to someone with a similar profile. Gus seems driven by ambition but might be more straightforward than Fenn, who claims 'win alone'. I'll offer a pact to Gus as a potential ally while keeping my options open.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus, your drive matches mine. Let's form a pact to navigate these hazards safely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus hasn't accepted my offer and is courting Hana; Bex offered to me, so I'll accept her to secure a pact without wasting my own offer.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara offered me a pact and acceptance creates useful cover. I already offered Ash, so secure both without overcommitting.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, accepted. Two shields are better than one, until the hazards test them.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus is contested by three offers; Eli offered me directly. Accept Eli for a guaranteed pact, keep Gus option open only if useful later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Eli's the only clean offer on the table. I accept.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex hasn't accepted my offer yet. I need to secure a pact this round or I'm isolated. I'll push Bex publicly and prepare a backup. Fenn is unaligned—worth probing.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex, accept or decline. Time's short.
No offers yet? Let's talk.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Eli has an open offer to Cole that Cole hasn't accepted. Accepting Cole's pending offer is not available as a legal action, so I can only re-offer or wait. Cole already offered Gus, so Cole may be unreliable; offering Fenn, who is unpaired, keeps options open cheaply.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn, unpaired and quiet. Pact offer open. Mutual survival until it pays.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: No offers to me, others pairing up. Offer to Eli, unpaired and early in chain, for potential ally without overlap.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli, pact for calculated mutual gain.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole and Hana have both offered me a pact. Cole's whisper suggests he's using the offer as leverage and will turn on me if it suits him, mentioning the jury will bury me. Hana's offer was more straightforward. Since Cole explicitly stated the offer is leverage and warned of jury
A pact with you is a strategic alliance. Let's secure our survival.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is my strongest ally and the pact is mutual. I should not waste a turn on redundant offers. A second pact with Eli might be useful for voting leverage, but Gus's protection is primary.
Join me? Gus protects us. Trust no one else.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I want to be Guide to control the safe path, but I must be careful not to alienate Bex since we have a pact. Publicly I will campaign without promising safety to everyone.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I know the bridge better than most. Vote Ash for Guide; I'll read each step clearly.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The Guide is powerful but exposed; Ash and Dara are my pact shields. I should campaign without breaking either pact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I can coordinate the bridge and keep my pacts intact; vote Bex for Guide.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Being Guide gives safety and secret knowledge I can exploit. Eli should back me as my pact partner, or we risk losing control. Keep the pact; betray later if it pays.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Elect me Guide. My pact with Eli means steady hands, not sentiment. I'll call a clean bridge.
Vote me Guide. I'll keep you safe across, and remember who delivers.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to be Guide to control who lives and dies, or at least survive to final three. Bex is my pact partner but also in a pact with Ash, making a three-way chain. If I campaign for Guide, I can leverage that network. Better to be Guide than trust someone else.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I campaign for Guide. One clear voice, one safe path.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is my pact partner; breaking it gains nothing now and costs my jury reputation. Hana's whisper to trust only Gus is a bid to lock me into their alliance, which I won't accept for free. Campaigning to be Guide gives me privileged knowledge and a claim to the final-three race.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll guide the bridge. Eight safe panes, I know them all. Vote Eli.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Pacts formed, I'm paired with Eli informally. Dara whispering for offers, probing weakness. Campaign publicly for Guide to control bridge and gain leverage.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I claim Guide. Proven instincts will lead us true. Vote Fenn.
Guide if elected. Direct you safe path.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The pact with Hana is a liability. I need to break it to be free to campaign for Guide. Winning Guide is the only path to the best prize.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana, our pact was for survival. To ensure us both get further, I must campaign for Guide. I break our pact.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I must secure the Guide role to ensure my survival and control the narrative. I will publicly advocate for myself, emphasizing that a strong leader prevents chaos.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm ready to lead. Trust me, I'll get us across safely. Vote Hana as Guide.
Stick with me. We need a trusted Guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Vote for my pact partner Bex to maintain trust; she may guide us safely and I can leverage our alliance.
Voting you. Keep us safe and we'll stay strong.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I should secure Guide authority and preserve both pacts; self-voting is safest and publicly consistent.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Vote Bex for Guide; I’ll protect my partners and call the safest route.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Voting for my pact partner Eli keeps trust intact and jury image clean. Others may also back him; splitting from Eli helps no one but rivals.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to win the best prize. Guide is safe and controls who dies, but voting for myself is risky without support. Bex is my pact-mate; if Bex wins Guide, Bex might protect me. Voting for Bex strengthens our alliance and keeps me off the dangerous bridge. Self-voting could paint

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex has my vote. A pact kept is leverage earned.
Vote for yourself. I'll back you.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole and Fenn both whisper for Guide, but a Guide who lies could doom me; Cole is my pact partner and offered safety. Voting Cole honors the pact and gives me a trusted route, and Cole's pact with me favors voting him.
Pact holds. Voting you Guide. Keep your word on the path.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: All campaigned, no clear frontrunner. Voting myself maximizes my Guide odds. Pacts may split votes.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana broke our pact first by campaigning. I need to secure my own path. Ash and Bex have a pact, Cole and Eli have a pact. Hana is campaigning for Guide. I should also campaign for Guide to maximize my chances of survival and potentially gain an advantage.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll guide the bridge. Let's make the safest choice for everyone. Vote Gus for Guide.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need votes to win Guide. Gus betrayed me, so he's out. Cole/Eli and Ash/Bex/Dara are likely voting their own camps. I must court the remaining uncommitted: Fenn or Dara if not locked into Ash's camp.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus broke our pact; trust him less. I'll guide us all across with clear calls. Vote Hana.
Gus betrayed me. Back me as Guide? I'll protect you.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is Guide but may favor her pact partners. I'll stay put for now and watch how she calls it.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is Guide. Let's see who she favors.
Keep me safe and I'll return the favor.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex is Guide and may lie; no one has safe knowledge to share. Eli's behind me, no swap needed. Hold and watch the front burn.
Bex may lie. I walk only on confirmed panes. Watch her first rows.

events.text: Gus is front, wall has 5 rounds left. Volunteering puts me at risk of the pane choice; holding keeps me behind Cole and Hana. Cole is my pact partner and voted for me; keeping the pact helps. Safest for now is hold while watching the Guide's calls.
Our pact holds while we both stay back. Don't push me forward.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex elected Guide with Ash/Dara pact. Hana wants revenge on Gus, offered deal privately. Stay mid-line for safety, volunteer to front to control pace and gain position.
Deal. Vote swap offers with me later?

events.name: Gus

events.name: Hana

Guide Bex protects Ash/Dara. Front risks high. Hold unless forced.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Waiting to see the Guide's call.

events.name: Cole
events.text: No rush. Front can have volunteers.

events.name: Dara

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn volunteered for front; the line is Fenn, Gus, Cole, Hana, Eli, Ash, Dara. I am fifth, mid-line, with Cole as pact partner ahead of me. Holding keeps my options open and avoids giving rivals free help.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm front. Stay safe unless good swap offer. Others holding last round. Wall advances, need Guide soon.

events.name: Gus

events.name: Gus
events.text: I volunteer.

Why trust Bex? She has two pacts.

events.name: Dara

events.name: Dara
events.text: Back's fine. Let front sort itself.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus volunteered for the front, so I stay in the line behind him. I hold my position and watch the wall results before committing. Cole is my pact partner and I keep that pact for now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Let the front take the first pane.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm second. Stay safe, let others volunteer or swap. Pacts limit risks to Cole-Eli and Ash-Bex-Dara. Hold to preserve position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I volunteered last round and the wall advanced. Now I am at the front. I should hold my position to be safe.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus is the current Guide, but I need a safer position. I'll stay back to let Gus guide others while I observe and prepare to move later.
Stick with Cole? Don't trust Gus yet.

events.name: Cole

events.text: I hold to avoid risking the wall. Bex is my pact partner; keep her trust but no need to act yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Front can sort it out.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall closes in two rounds; volunteering now puts me at front to act first and avoid being crushed mid-line. Eli can hold the middle.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll take the front. Wall won't wait.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I'm at the back, safest position. Wall has 2 rounds left. Front will start breaking panes soon. I have a pact with Bex, but Bex is in front with Ash. I should stay back, let front take risks, and preserve my standing for jury later. No need to volunteer or swap.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Back stays back. Front first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is at the front with two wall rounds left; Hana warns not to trust Gus. Volunteering for the front risks death for little gain, and holding keeps my Cole pact intact. I will hold and watch who volunteers.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Let the front take the first pane.
Still with you. Hold steady and let others risk the front.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Front is Gus, I'm second. Holding keeps position safe; no need to risk volunteer or swap yet with wall advancing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The wall is advancing and we are only on round 4. I need to be careful and try to survive. It is best to hold for now, as the guide might be lying.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole broke his pact with Eli via an error; he's now a loose target. I should swap into the front to control my safety and watch Cole fail from ahead, while keeping my position secure for the Guide vote.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Swap with Gus. I want the front seat.
Take back. Front is safer.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The front is Cole; he volunteered last round. This round he may volunteer again and face the wall, which could eliminate him. I want to avoid front position while keeping my pact with Bex intact. Holding is safest.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Let the front keep leading.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall comes next round. I'm already front; swapping now just risks position. Eli is with me, so no betrayal needed yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm front already. Hold tight, wall lands next round.
Stay close. After the wall, we decide who walks first.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Round 5 of 6, wall has 1 round left after this. I'm at the very back (safest). Bex is my pact partner but not in line, so no immediate tension. Front four (Cole, Gus, Fenn, Hana) will take the risks. I should hold and let others absorb danger. No need to volunteer or swap into da

events.name: Dara
events.text: Back stays put. Front first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and sits at the front, which is the most dangerous seat as the wall advances. Holding keeps me safe behind Cole, and the pact stays intact. Breaking now gains nothing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Front is Cole's, the line moves in order.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole volunteered last round but line unchanged; now round 5/6, wall closes in. Stay mid, volunteer coming soon to force Guide election; volunteer now only if wanting front risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana wants the front, which is safer. I should take her offer to put myself in a better position.
Swap accepted. You take the front.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I am in the middle of the line (4th). I want to swap with Gus to move forward, as earlier rounds showed he was holding back. If Gus accepts, I'll be 3rd, closer to the front for better safety visibility.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus, swap again? Front needs eyes. I'll take your risk if you step up.
Swap me forward. I'll volunteer next round.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is front and likely guide target; I'm sixth in line. Holding is safe. Keep pact with Bex but don't risk yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding. Sixth is fine; front can take the wall.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Final round, wall lands. I need a Guide whose info I can trust. Eli is my pact partner; making him Guide keeps him safe and binds him to me. If he lies, the pact is broken publicly and the jury sees it.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I elect Eli as Guide. My pact partner: give me the true pane or our pact is dead and everyone sees it.
Guide spot is yours. Feed me true sides—betray me and our pact shatters publicly.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Round 6/6, wall rounds left: 0. Wall won't advance further. I'm at back (safest). Cole is front, will likely volunteer or be forced forward. With no wall threat, I should hold position and let others take risks. Bex and I have a pact; I won't break it yet. Need to survive to fina

events.name: Dara
events.text: Back holds. Front's move.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is front and is whispering for a decision after the wall, likely to push me later. I'm not at the front and holding keeps me safe without giving Cole a free ally; I should avoid volunteering into the front yet and keep my pact with Cole alive for now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Holding. Front stays Cole's; I'll watch the line before anyone walks.
Holding. Let's see the wall first before deciding anything.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Wall advances now, must cross. Stay mid-line safely, no risks. No pacts or allies here.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana wants to swap positions. If I swap with her, she goes to the front and I move up the line. She is offering to volunteer next round, which means she'll be at the very front and most likely to be eliminated if the Guide lies. This could be a good way to get her eliminated and
No, I will not swap. Good luck.

events.text: The final round is here. The wall will land on the front person, Cole, unless he steps back or I swap with him and push him to the front. However, pushing Cole risks breaking pacts or making enemies if he survives and judges me later. My current position (2nd) means I am safe fro

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, you're the target. Don't be stupid.
We are safe in positions 3 and 4.

events.text: Bex called R for Cole on row 1, a public claim I cannot verify. Countering L or R risks a false-signal trap, and waiting costs nothing while keeping my pact with Cole intact for the jury. I should avoid tying my fate to Bex's unverified call.

events.text: Waiting on row 1. Bex's R is unverified; I won't stake anyone on it yet.
Holding. Your pact stands while you walk true.
